payload.register:
TWENTY-NINE requirements. EARS shapes; kind, verify_method and breaks_if_removed on every row; source_refs to the use-case steps they derive from.

-- READING AND SEARCHING (UC-A) --

R1 PARTIAL READ (functional). WHEN asked for a byte or line range of a product file, SE SHALL return exactly that range and report the total extent. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a 132k-char file is unreadable through the lane, which is today's state and the leading suspect for three design-doc-to-build losses. source: UC-A step 3.

R2 OVERSIZE REFUSES, NEVER TRUNCATES (functional, unwanted-behaviour). IF a requested read exceeds the response cap, THEN SE SHALL refuse with the actual size and a remedy naming the range parameters. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a silently truncated file reads as a complete one - the confident-wrong-answer class this iteration exists to remove. source: UC-A ext 3a.

R3 MATCHES CARRY CONTEXT (functional). WHEN searching, SE SHALL return each match with its path, line number and a caller-specified number of surrounding lines. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a ruling cannot be read around a hit; measured cost today was four calls where one should do. source: UC-A step 4.

R4 SEARCH IS FILTERABLE (functional). SE SHALL accept glob and file-type filters, and SHALL offer a list-files-only mode. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: 'where does this pattern of files live' degrades to directory walking; there is no glob today. source: UC-A step 3.

R5 THE RECORD IS SEARCHABLE (functional). SE SHALL search git refs - tags and branches - not only the working tree. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: since i5d withheld iteration evidence from trunk, NO shipped iteration's evidence is findable at all. source: UC-A ext 3c.

R6 A FILE IS READABLE AT A REF (functional). SE SHALL read a file's content at a named ref. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: v1 (branch main) and every closed iteration's evidence stay unreadable. source: UC-A ext 3c.

R7 OUTSIDE SOURCES ARE ADDRESSED BY DECLARED NAME (functional). WHERE a source lies outside the repository, SE SHALL address it by a declared @name, and SHALL refuse an undeclared root with a remedy that declares it. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: either the lane cannot reach outside sources at all, or reads become untraceable absolute paths the owner cannot audit. source: UC-A ext 3b.

R8 REQUIRED ARGS ARE ENFORCED (constraint). SE SHALL refuse any call missing a declared required argument, and SHALL NOT coerce a missing value. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: witnessed - a wrong arg name made search look for the literal word 'undefined' and return confident, irrelevant hits. binding norm: se.law-whitelist-guards. source: UC-A ext 4b.

R9 CONSULTATION IS LOGGED BY NAME (functional). SE SHALL record every read and search with the source it consulted, naming declared roots and refs rather than absolute paths. verify: test plus inspection. breaks_if_removed: the owner cannot audit a run they did not watch, which se.law-responsibility-never-delegates makes their burden. source: UC-A step 6.

R10 NO MATCH IS SAID PLAINLY (functional). WHEN a search matches nothing, SE SHALL say so. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: an empty result is indistinguishable from a broken query. source: UC-A ext 4a.

-- WRITING (UC-B) --

R11 BATCHED EDITS (functional). SE SHALL accept many file edits in one call, each carrying its own guard. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: measured - se_file_patch is the most-used product tool at 645 calls and the most-failing at 28, and it produced a hand-rolled sweep script in i8d. source: UC-B step 2.

R12 A BATCH IS ATOMIC (functional). IF any edit in a batch fails its guard, THEN SE SHALL apply NONE of them and SHALL name which failed and why. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a half-applied batch leaves the tree in a state no hash describes. source: UC-B ext 2a.

R13 THE PRODUCT HAS ONE WRITER (constraint). SE SHALL treat se_file_* as the only writer to the product, and SHALL detect and record a product mutation made by any other lane. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: se_run remains an invisible writer - no CAS guard, no diff, no provenance; witnessed when a script rewrote six files with no ledger trace. binding norm: se.law-whitelist-guards. source: draw_context.

-- THE MACHINE JUDGING ITSELF (UC-C) --

R14 GUIDANCE REACHES THE PACKET (functional). WHEN serving a work packet, SE SHALL include every guidance and decision node whose applies_to matches that state, with wikilinks resolved to content. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: four laws minted on 2026-07-25 would never reach any packet; an arriving session cannot conform to rules it is never handed. source: UC-A step 1, S3.

R15 GUIDANCE VOLUME IS MEASURED (quality: usability). SOURCE: an agent receiving a packet. STIMULUS: guidance joined from many matching nodes. ARTIFACT: the work packet. ENVIRONMENT: normal operation. RESPONSE: the packet reports its guidance size. MEASURE: guidance size is present in the packet and reviewable per state. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: the join's cost stays invisible until the agent is skimming, which is a silent failure - nothing refuses and the rules stop being read. source: se.raid-the-guidance-join-buries-the-instruction.

R16 LINT VERDICTS ARE THE EVIDENCE (functional). WHERE a gate declares a lint for a check, SE SHALL run it and SHALL record its verdict as that field's evidence instead of prompting the agent for prose. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: gates keep asking the agent to vouch for its own work - the mechanism behind i8d's ten self-blessed gates and three escaped defects. source: UC-C steps 2-3.

R17 A LINT DECIDES OR DEFERS (constraint). A lint SHALL yield exactly pass, fail, or defer-to-judgement; it SHALL NOT block awaiting input. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: an unattended run stops at 3am for a human who is deliberately absent, inverting the delegation the project is built for. binding norm: se.law-responsibility-never-delegates. source: UC-C ext 2a.

R18 LINTS COMPUTE FACTS (constraint). A lint SHALL decide only on facts derivable from the record - files, evidence, run results, ledger edges - and SHALL NOT judge intent or quality. verify: inspection plus test. breaks_if_removed: lints that judge intent refuse correct work, and the agent's rational response is to route around them - replacing 'the tools are too weak' with 'the checks are too dumb'. source: se.raid-a-wrong-lint-becomes-the-new-workaround-pressure.

R19 A FAILING LINT NAMES THE FACT (functional). WHEN a lint fails, SE SHALL report the fact that did not hold. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a mechanical refusal without its fact is unarguable and undebuggable. source: UC-C ext 3a.

R20 COMPUTED AND ASSERTED ARE DISTINGUISHABLE (functional). SE SHALL record, per gate, which checks were computed and which asserted, readable without parsing prose. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: the owner cannot tell what a delegated bless rested on - the audit half of se.law-responsibility-never-delegates. source: UC-C step 6.

R21 THE SCAN IS COLLECTED (functional). WHERE a state's guidance requires a state-of-the-art or prior-art scan, its evidence form SHALL carry a field for it. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: this iteration's own retro finding - the check exists in guidance at write_requirements, is collected nowhere, and has therefore never been performed. source: the retro.

-- THE RECORD (UC-D) --

R22 THE GRANT NAMES THE COMMIT (functional). WHEN closing, SE SHALL record the evidence COMMIT HASH in the grant, beside the tag name. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: the pointer is a name anyone can delete; a hash reachable from trunk's merge parent cannot be orphaned. source: UC-D step 2.

R23 TAGS ARE ANNOTATED (functional). SE SHALL create iteration tags as annotated objects carrying the iteration's goal and closing gate. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: verified today - push.followTags carries ONLY annotated tags, so the config every VS Code user would set pushes commits and silently drops every iter/* tag. source: UC-D step 3.

R24 THE BRANCH GOES AFTER THE MERGE (functional). WHEN a close merges successfully, SE SHALL delete the iteration branch. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a branch and a tag share the name iter/<id>, which git already warns is ambiguous - so ref-scoped record search is unreliable on exactly the refs it must use. source: UC-D step 4, ext 5a.

R25 followTags IS CONFIGURED (functional). SE SHALL set push.followTags idempotently for the repository. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a VS Code user pushing from the UI carries no tags and does not find out. source: UC-D step 3.

-- CONFIGURATION --

R26 THE MACHINE-LOCAL CONFIG HAS A LANE (functional). SE SHALL show, set and validate the machine-local configuration, including root paths, the pairing and the brief store. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: witnessed - enabling the brief store needed a hand-rolled script, and the owner asked why the tools were not used; they do not exist. source: draw_context, se.raid-no-lane-for-machine-local-config.

R27 SECRETS STAY MASKED (constraint). SE SHALL NOT return or log a credential value from the config lane. verify: test plus inspection. breaks_if_removed: a credential reaches the record. binding norm: the discipline i8 kept for the ntfy token.

-- FOUND BY THE PRIOR-ART SCAN, not derived from the use cases --

R28 SUBPROCESS CALLS ARE BOUNDED (constraint). SE SHALL bound every external search process by a timeout and SHALL cap its result count and per-line length. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a pathological pattern or a huge tree hangs the lane or floods the context - the standard failure of shelling out, and the exact class i8 already hit with an unbounded transport read.

R29 ROOTS ARE NOT ESCAPABLE (constraint). SE SHALL contain every read and search within the declared root it names, and SHALL refuse a path that escapes it. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: '@v1/../../..' reaches the whole disk, which turns a named, auditable read into an arbitrary one and voids R9's audit value.

-- DEMONSTRATION --

D1 (demonstration). The killer sequence SHALL be exercised end to end: in one iteration, the agent consults the design document by range, v1 by ref, and a closed iteration's evidence by record search, and writes NO script to do any of it. verify: demonstration. breaks_if_removed: the iteration's central claim goes untested, which is exactly how i8d shipped its unverified leg.
payload.set_criteria:
PRIOR-ART SCAN ON THE SET - run for real, because this is the check the retro found instructed-but-never-collected, and running it is also its own first test. QUESTION ASKED: what does the standard checklist for an agent file/search tool surface demand that this set was missing?

SCANNED AGAINST: the agent-harness read/search patterns recorded at frame_delta (offset/limit paging, refuse-and-redirect on oversize, path:line:text capped at max_results, context management as the driver), ripgrep's own flag surface as a de-facto checklist of what a search tool is expected to control, and our own history as prior art.

FOUR MISSES FOUND, ALL NOW ADDED - and I am recording that they were missing rather than presenting the set as if they were always there:
- RESULT CAPS AND LINE LENGTH: the field's convention is a max_results cap and a max-column limit; I had specified context but no ceiling. Added to R28.
- SUBPROCESS BOUNDING: shelling out without a timeout is the standard failure of this design, and we have hit its cousin before - i8's transport read needed an abort bound. Added to R28.
- PATH CONTAINMENT: every tool surface that admits named roots must refuse escapes from them; without it R9's audit value is void, since '@v1/../..' is an arbitrary read wearing a name. Added as R29.
- BINARY AND ENCODING HANDLING: partially covered - ripgrep skips binary by default and offers -E transcoding, and we were burned by a UTF-8 BOM once. Judged as an implementation obligation under R28's caps rather than a separate requirement; recorded here so the judgement is visible rather than an omission.

ONE MISS DELIBERATELY NOT ADDED: the field expects a semantic/retrieval layer for large codebases. Rejected with its reason at frame_delta - an index tolerates staleness, our agent reads back what it just wrote - and rejected again here rather than silently.

COMPLETE: every UC-A/B/C/D main step and numbered extension maps to at least one requirement; both killer stories are carried (S1 by R1-R7 and D1, S2 by R16-R20).
CONSISTENT: one failure philosophy - REFUSE RATHER THAN GUESS, applied uniformly (R2 oversize, R8 missing args, R10 no match, R12 atomic batch, R19 failing lint, R29 escape). The single apparent exception is R17's defer, which is not a guess but an explicit handoff to judgement.
AFFORDABLE: one dependency, one new module (lints), one new tool (se_config), extensions to four existing modules, and DELETIONS - the hand-rolled searcher goes, so the surface does not only grow.
BOUNDED: draw_context's twelve excluded-use lines bind; nothing here indexes, judges intent, parks a run, or pushes.
NO TBD.

HONEST LIMIT NAMED: R16 and R20 assume a gate can DECLARE which of its checks are lintable and that the M4 element allocation is machine-readable enough for the models-adhered lint. The second half is not yet known and is the one thing in this set resting on an untested assumption - it goes to M5 as a spike rather than being asserted here. If it fails, R16 survives with a smaller set of lints and S2's slide 2 changes.
